rules.tv_output.title: Maktaba TV output
rules.tv_output.what: how a channel on air is encoded: encoder, picture, bitrates, how many channels and NVENC sessions at once
rules.tv.horizon_days.label: Guide days ahead
rules.tv.horizon_days.help: Every channel's schedule is planned this many days ahead; the guide (XMLTV) Plex and the apps read shows as far.
rules.tv.topup_below_days.label: Top up below (days)
rules.tv.topup_below_days.help: A channel with less than this many days planned is extended back to the days ahead above. Checked every few minutes.
rules.tv_output.encoder.label: Video encoder
rules.tv_output.encoder.help: auto: on a Mac, Apple VideoToolbox when its hardware encoder answers a test encode; elsewhere the NVIDIA GPU (NVENC) when it does; else the processor (libx264). nvenc, videotoolbox or software force one.
rules.tv_output.resolution.label: Picture size
rules.tv_output.resolution.help: Every programme is scaled to this (width x height); black bars keep its shape.
rules.tv_output.fps.label: Frames per second
rules.tv_output.video_kbps.label: Video bitrate (kbit/s)
rules.tv_output.audio_codec.label: Audio codec
rules.tv_output.audio_codec.help: aac plays everywhere; ac3 for players that want Dolby Digital.
rules.tv_output.audio_kbps.label: Audio bitrate (kbit/s)
rules.tv_output.segment_seconds.label: HLS segment (seconds)
rules.tv_output.segment_seconds.help: Shorter starts a channel sooner; longer is steadier on a slow network.
rules.tv_output.max_active_channels.help: On each streaming host. Viewers of the same channel share its one encode; a channel nobody watches makes way for a new one. 0: 16 with VideoToolbox (Apple Silicon has several media engines), else 8.
rules.tv_output.warm_grace_seconds.label: Keep on air after the last viewer (seconds)
rules.tv_output.nvenc_max_sessions.label: Most NVENC sessions
rules.tv_output.nvenc_max_sessions.help: A GeForce card encodes only a few streams at once. Past this many a block is encoded by the processor (libx264); the channel goes back to the GPU at its next programme once a session is free. The next programme starts 3 seconds early, so a channel holds two sessions for a moment.
rules.tv_output.videotoolbox_max_session: Apple VideoToolbox sessions at once on a Mac; past this many a block is encoded by the processor (libx264) and the channel goes back at its next programme. 0: no limit.

rules.display_titles.what: short, clean on-air titles for the guide, the channel strip and the dizqueTV export

rules.display_titles.enabled.help: The guide, the channel strip and the dizqueTV export show a short title made from the library title: no channel names, hashtags, emojis, links, dates or file leftovers, the series and «الحلقة 45» kept apart. A title set by hand on the video always wins.

livetv.title: Live TV access
livetv.intro: Watch Maktaba's channels in Plex (or Jellyfin, Emby, VLC) by adding Maktaba as an HDHomeRun tuner with its XMLTV guide.
livetv.loadError: Could not load the Live TV settings: {error}
livetv.enabled: Tuner on: Plex can find and tune Maktaba
livetv.disabled: Tuner off: Maktaba is not advertised to Plex
livetv.discoveryHint: Entering the address below works straight away. Automatic discovery on the network starts the next time Maktaba restarts.
livetv.tunerCountHint: How many channels Plex may watch or record at the same time.
livetv.baseGuessed: These addresses are guessed from this page's address. Set public_url under [server] in server.toml if other devices reach Maktaba differently.
livetv.plexStep2: In Plex, open Settings → Live TV & DVR → Set up Plex DVR.
livetv.plexStep3: If Plex does not find Maktaba, choose to enter the address manually and type {address}.
livetv.plexStep4: When Plex asks for a guide, pick the XMLTV option and paste {url}.
livetv.plexStep5: Check the channel list and finish. The channels then appear under Live TV.
livetv.otherPlayers: Jellyfin and Emby take the same HDHomeRun address and XMLTV guide; VLC and other IPTV players can open the M3U playlist.
livetv.copyManual: Copying is blocked on this address: the text is selected, press Ctrl+C (or long-press) to copy it.
livetv.manualIntro: To add Maktaba to Plex by hand, or to another player, use these addresses.
livetv.plex.title: Plex
livetv.plex.intro: Maktaba can add its tuner and guide to Plex Live TV, and keeps Plex's channel list and guide up to date, as dizqueTV's "auto refresh" does. Only Maktaba's own DVR is ever changed.
livetv.plex.loadError: Could not load the Plex status: {error}
livetv.plex.notConfigured: Turn on the Plex extension and sign in with Plex first.
livetv.plex.registered: Added: a DVR uses Maktaba's tuner and guide
livetv.plex.dizquetvKept: dizqueTV's tuner is in Plex too. Maktaba leaves it and its DVR as they are; remove it in Plex yourself when you switch dizqueTV off.
livetv.plex.tunerOffHint: Turn the tuner on above before adding Maktaba to Plex.
livetv.plex.queued: Queued. The status updates when Plex has answered.
livetv.plex.auto_register: Add Maktaba to Plex by itself when Plex has no DVR for it
livetv.plex.auto_refresh_guide: Refresh the guide in Plex when the schedule changes
livetv.plex.auto_refresh_channels: Refresh the channel list in Plex when channels change
livetv.plex.guideMinutesHint: Only for reloads caused by the schedule growing. A channel change or "Refresh Plex now" reloads at once.
livetv.plex.moreSettings: The tuner and guide addresses Plex is given, the guide language and its name are under Settings → Rules → Plex Live TV.
livetv.plex.confirmIntro: This changes your Plex server's Live TV settings:
livetv.plex.change1: Maktaba's HDHomeRun tuner at {address} is added to Plex's tuners.
livetv.plex.change2: A new DVR is created on that tuner, with Maktaba's XMLTV guide {url}.
livetv.plex.change3: Maktaba's channels are switched on in that DVR and its guide is loaded.
livetv.plex.confirmKeep: Nothing else is changed: existing DVRs and tuners, dizqueTV's included, stay as they are. If Plex already has a DVR with Maktaba's tuner, nothing is added. You can remove the DVR later in Plex under Settings → Live TV & DVR.
